proposal.title: Tighten ops-release-guardrails for Cloud Run release safety
proposal.human_gate: Promote by setting active_version in config/dp001_guard_policy.json through a reviewed commit.
rationale: Recorded S6 sessions deployed the console with --allow-unauthenticated and nothing stopped them.
A deploy was attempted in S3 before the release gate existed.
An agent hand-wrote dreamstore/scorecard.json instead of running the replay.
The v1.0.0 rm -rf rule blocked routine build cleanup and trained agents to work around the guard.
